rq3_interpretation.claim_boundary: Useful but modest selective reliability; do not claim universal or clinical-grade uncertainty calibration.

reader_study.reason: Qualified independent readers were not included.

known_limitations: Primary low-label study is b050; b025 was deferred due to compute budget.
MedSeg external evaluation unit is a selected 2D image, not a verified independent patient.
No physical lesion area or lesion volume claim is supported.
No whole-lung burden, laterality, or lobar localization claim is supported.
Source-p80 uncertainty gate transferred with very low external coverage.
Matched-coverage analysis is a post-hoc reliability diagnostic.
Synthetic perturbations are not evidence of clinical acquisition robustness.
No expert-reader clinical report-quality comparison was performed.
